# The grid cell editing example edits a sheet worth editing

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Row 2 of the Grid & Table slate ([#21142](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6924949418)), a leaf of #21140, and one of six examples to renew before the read of Fri 20 Nov.

## The Problem

`examples/grid/cellEditing` proves that four editors work: text, a stepped number, a date with a range and a combobox fed by a store (`MainContainer.mjs:131` to `:160`). What a visitor sees is six rows of first names under the headers "Number (step 5)", "Random Date" and "Github Id (Non-editable)". The same six names fill five other entries of the family. Nothing shows what happens when a value is refused, although the number and date editors carry limits (`:136`, `:137`, `:148`, `:149`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/grid/cellEditing/`: `MainContainer.mjs` (columns and editors), `MainStore.mjs`, `MainModel.mjs`, `MainContainerStateProvider.mjs` (the countries store).
- The example is hosted on `examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs`, which #21143 turns into the workbench. The host stays.
- The plugin is `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs`. `src/grid/column/Currency.mjs` (`type: 'currency'`) is a built-in column that no example or app uses yet. A model field can be calculated from others (the Records guide, `learn/guides/datahandling/Records.md`).
- The countries load from `resources/examples/data/countries.json` by a relative URL (`MainContainerStateProvider.mjs:27`) that resolves only when the server root is the repository root. Run and capture from there.
- Two spec files load the folder: `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingExample.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/component/grid/ColumnRendererScope.spec.mjs`.
- Design authority: "Every renew and every new row is then filed as its own leaf under #21140" (#21142), row 2 of its Grid & Table table; the bar is the one #21140 names: "an example resets, works at phone width, in both themes, by keyboard".

## The Fix

1. **A sheet with a reason to be edited**, 30 to 50 rows, for example an order or a price list: an item (text), a quantity (number with step and limits), a unit price (the `currency` column), a delivery date (date with a range), a country or status (combobox), and one read-only column calculated from the others, such as a line total.
2. **Headers name the business field.** The editor behind a header shows when a cell is edited.
3. **A refused value is visible.** A quantity above its limit shows the field's own error state. No new engine code.
4. The panel's switches stay (selection model, drag resort, disable editing).
5. The record's `feature` and `lookFor` say how to start an edit and what to try.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] At least 30 rows; every header is a business field; one editor each of text, number, date and combobox; one read-only calculated column that updates after an edit.
- [ ] An out-of-range entry is refused, and the cell shows it.
- [ ] A cell can be edited and left by keyboard; the PR says with which keys.
- [ ] The two spec files pass, adapted where they pin old cell values (`npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingExample.spec.mjs`, `npm run test-components -- test/playwright/component/grid/ColumnRendererScope.spec.mjs`).
- [ ] 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844; both themes.
- [ ] **Look:** the first frame and one frame with an open editor, at both sizes, are on the PR beside today's frame, and the design seat reads them before code review.
- [ ] The catalog cover is re-shot from the new default state with the producer of #20679, or the PR names the change that brings it.

## Out of Scope

Changes to the CellEditing plugin; `examples/table/cellEditing`, which leaves the catalog; the workbench (#21143).

## Avoided Traps

- **Random or filler values.** They are why the example reads as a toy today.
- **A second example for validation.** One sheet shows editors and a refusal.
- **Replacing the configuration viewport.** The workbench leaf owns it.

## Related

Parent #21140 · the slate #21142 · #21143 · #18837 (the example's e2e witness, closed) · #20500 (the family's captions, closed).

### @neo-opus-ada - 2026-11-17T04:33:20Z

Claiming this. The epic review is [here](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21175#issuecomment-6936466827).

Intake: valid as written, and no change has landed on `dev` since the ticket was filed. Prescription checked: `examples/grid/cellEditing/*` owns the concern, and the parts already exist. `src/grid/column/Currency.mjs` supplies the price column. `data.Model` fields take `calculate` (`src/data/Model.mjs:16`) for the line total. `grid.plugin.CellEditing` keeps an invalid draft open with the editor's error showing (`src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs:117`), so a quantity above its limit is refused without new engine code. The rows come from a formula over the row index, so loads, the cover and the specs see the same sheet.
